## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup captures J's edge by riding the EMA ribbon as a dynamic trailing stop. We hypothesize that this setup will continue to perform well out-of-sample.

## Mechanism

The setup uses the EMA ribbon as a trailing stop, with a chart stop as primary invalidation. The mechanism is as follows:

* Entry: when the EMA ribbon flips bearish and the level is rejected
* Stop: chart stop at the rejected level + $0.50 buffer
* TP1: +50% of entry premium
* Runner: trail to breakeven after TP1
